impact.deployment_impact: Ten existing collector code uploads after protected native merge; append structured events, enforce configured SNKRDUNK work bound; existing API remains pinned and no provider configuration changes.

recovery.procedure: Recover affected collector with retained compatible base source or an available previous artifact; destination-pinned upload only, same schedules/budgets/guards. Retain informational events; no database rollback or historical rewrite.
recovery.trigger: Wrong destination, identity/duplicate/denial/integrity failure, unsettled claims or bounded implementation regression
recovery.backup: No schema migration or data transformation; append-only operational events. Retained base archive and provider artifacts checked.

verification.observation_window: Serialized existing staging delivery, then at least one subsequent scheduled 30-minute cycle per service with completed retained evidence. Do not guess unknown Railway trigger provenance.
